name: Mushrooms
summary: Mushrooms, Inc. is a biotechnology company that develops products from mushrooms and mycelium. The company focuses on mycelium's industrial applications for carbon-neutral products, health supplements, and technologies for healthcare and textiles, such as bacterial detection and nutrient delivery. The company was formerly known as Marijuana Strategic Ventures Inc. and changed its name to Mushrooms Inc. in October 2022. [20, 22, 28, 33]
